text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm walking the academy
grounds when I
spot Tokai Teio. She
seems to be searching for
something.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sort of? It's kind of complicated...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's not here either... And she said
she
already looked there...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she twirled her pen so hard it
flew like a
propeller up into a tree... All
right! I'll take a look!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Stooop! What do you mean, "All right,"
Tsuru?!
Why are you trying to climb that
tree?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Teio! One of the younger students
said she
lost her pen, so I was helping
her find it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru always helps friends in need,
which is great, but she gets weird ideas
in her head sometimes. I
can't just leave
her on her own.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... I did a quick run around the building, but no luck!
choice_data_list: Huh? Where did that Tsurumaru Tsuy...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
O-oh... Oh dear... I-I feel another dizzy
spell
coming on!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You're working yourself way too
hard!
Come on, focus on your breathing
for a bit,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah... Haha! Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It's just that,
if I see a younger student in need, I
want to do what I can! Go that
extra minute for
them, you know?

I think you mean "go that extra mile."
But I admire
your desire to do your
utmost.

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text:
Prez?!
President Rudolf?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to join the search. After all, is
it not the
duty of a senior student to
help their juniors when
they need it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We were heading back to the student
council office to sign off on some
documents, but they'll
hold until
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If it's the job of senior students to help
their
juniors, then it's the job of a trainer
to support
the students.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone! I can't tell you
how grateful
I am that you went so far to
help me!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That pen is suuuuper important to you,
isn't it?
Keep it close from now on,
okay? Bye...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Cough, hack! O-oof. Talk about ruining the mood!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aww, you don't have to beat yourself
up. The way
she was cradling that pen...
I'm pretty sure she got
your message!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trust me—I'm a super genius with a mind
as sharp
as a knife, so I know what I'm
talking about!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you think? Oh, what am I saying,
you're
right! Thanks, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just that I'm blinded by the
light
of their
forthrightness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They saw a student in need and lent a
hand,
working together to solve the
problem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This academy is blessed to have so many

kindhearted students and trainers...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I got a glimpse of the bright
future
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I got a glimpse of the bright
future
ahead.
choice_data_list: It was a great learning experience...
It was a great learning experience...
I can't wait to see that future.
I can't wait to see that future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We're of the same mind. I, too, gleaned
much
from this experience. I owe them
both.
choice_data_list: It was a great learning experience...
It was a great learning experience...
I can't wait to see that future.
I can't wait to see that future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text:
You bet!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I couldn't agree more.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did I hear you say it's still bright
enough to
run? Are we going for a run
now?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, yeah! I'm also ready to run, since I
always
stay on top of my stretches!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha! Well then, who am I to refuse?
